The propensity score of a ps_data object on the probability scale

Source: R/utils.R
dot-probability_score.Rd

A ps_match() object built with scale = "logit" names a logit column in $meta$score_col. Readers that need a probability call this helper, which applies stats::plogis() when $meta$scale is "logit" and otherwise returns the column unchanged, then checks that every value lies in [0, 1].

Usage

.probability_score(
  x,
  score_col = x$meta$score_col,
  call_env = rlang::caller_env()
)

Arguments

x

A ps_data object.

score_col

Name of the score column. Default x$meta$score_col.

call_env

Environment for the error call.

Value

A numeric vector of probabilities, one per row of x$data.
